values.value: Finds: DecisionTable records whose Status is anything other than 'Active' (Draft, Inactive, etc). Why it matters: ARM pricing procedures route through decision tables; non-active tables get skipped at runtime, so pricing branches you think are wired up silently fall through to defaults. Customers see fallback prices rather than the negotiated tier. Suppress a finding: for decision tables intentionally parked in Draft pending a contract negotiation that finance hasn't signed off on yet. Disable the detector: only if your ARM org uses pricing procedures without decision tables — rare; most Revenue Cloud configurations rely on them for tiered pricing.
